stage: Post-fit diagnostic, frozen before obtaining the site diagnostic outcomes. It changes no optimization, model selection, whole-task rollout, decision gate or sample size.
panels: Independently report the same held-out development programs/rows and all 764 eligible fresh external LEAPS programs used in the whole-task evaluation, with all six leave-one-world-out queries each. Count total programs, unique program token hashes, worlds, zero-primitive worlds, worlds without move, and non-STOP query steps. Only an actually occurred primitive is an evaluable target.
reference: In a separate scoring oracle, walk the published AST. A primitive's static source site is its ordered path of statement indexes and body/ifBody/elseBody relations. Every loop iteration revisits the same path. Check every emitted native primitive against the recorded trace, every terminal STOP and the full terminal grid for every original world. No AST, site IDs, source text, target next commands or target outputs enter model position weights.
ranking: At each query boundary the input is the four live bits and previous observed target command or BOS. Apply the original trained retrieval seed 17 and its exact untrained retrieval seed 17 independently, with the original five support traces, GRU, normalized keys, softmax of temperature-scaled cosine plus each position's existing log prior. The prior is one over the total number of real boundary positions in that donor including STOP. Original support padding retains zero probability. Consume the current teacher-forced command only after weights have been obtained. The separate clock comparator scores minus absolute difference in generic primitive index between target and support boundary. No future query observations, actions or target length help ranking.
primary_diagnostic: Hard positions have at least one support occurrence of the same static site and at least one occurrence of a different static site instructing the same primitive. Within each method, rank only support positions bearing the true primitive, applied after generating unfiltered model weights. Thus a preference for the primitive alone cannot establish source-site retrieval. Top-1 score is the fraction of exactly tied maximal-weight eligible support positions belonging to the target site; the clock uses the same tie rule. Repeated donor instances count separately. Report both micro by steps and macro by exact program token hash among codes with an eligible step; report eligible row/world/step denominators and how many eligible worlds never moved.
coverage: Also score all non-STOP steps (zero if the donor set has no position of the correct primitive) and all steps with at least one matching site, action-filtered in both cases. Count availability of the correct primitive and static site separately. Cases with zero observed actions or no ambiguous accessible site contribute to the full cohort accounting, not to the hard accuracy denominator. No significance or success threshold.
limits: Teacher-forced queries and action-conditioned offline ranking, not unrestricted demonstration retrieval or successful execution. Different sites can be semantically equivalent, repeated executions of one site's primitive can serve different purposes, and sparse hard-site support limits generality. No source labels are provided during fitting or control. No new fitting or policy comparison enters the original endpoint gate.
